Container.Name: kopia
Container.Overview: Kopia is a fast and secure open-source backup/restore tool that allows you to create encrypted snapshots of your data and save the snapshots to remote or cloud storage of your choice, to network-attached storage or server, or locally on your machine. Prepared by the Unraid Secretary Office's consultant: it runs as root (PUID/PGID 0) so it can read every file, sees the office's snapshots read-only at /uso and restores into /uso-restore. Choose the WebUI's user name and password below.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Appdata Path: Kopia's settings and its connection to the repository

Config.Name: Snapshots of the Secretary Office
Config.Description: Read Only - Slave: the snapshots Mr. Backupsy mounts for every night's run. Kopia names its sources after this container path (/uso/ + the share) - keep it.

Config.Name: Restore folder
Config.Description: Where Kopia restores files to (Mr. Restori)

Config.Name: Path: /cache
Config.Description: Temporary Uploads Path (Cache) - on a pool, not on the array

Config.Name: Path: /local
Config.Description: Path for local filesystem repositories (optional, e.g. an Unassigned Device)

Config.Name: PASSWORD
Config.Description: Choose a password for the WebUI - not kopia. Needed at the first start only (the image keeps it in /config/htpasswd).

Config.Name: KOPIA_PERSIST_CREDENTIALS_ON_CONNECT
Config.Description: Automatically connect to repository (the nightly run needs it)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: 0 (root): Kopia must read every file, also those only root may read

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: UMASK for newly created files. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

Config.Name: Installed by
Config.Description: A note of the Unraid Secretary Office: its consultant prepared this container. Changes nothing.
